actions.name: Cold Snap
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech makes an attack against multiple targets in an area as though the frostspear had the line weapon special property. The length of the line equals twice the mech's reach with the frostspear.

description.value:
A spear that channels intense cold.

Special: Cold Snap (2 PP) - On a hit, the target is staggered for 1 round.

system.special: reach, thrown (40 ft.), cold snap (2 PP)
